events.title: Pride with Buddies 2026
events.description: Buddies Spa and PMA Consulting celebrated Pride with the Mount Vernon Triangle community: a meet and greet with Jackie Cox (RuPaul's Drag Race), a free photo session with Jackie Cox, Bambi Necole Ferrah, Tiffany D. Carter and Sue Pozzie-Torrie, DJ music, live performances and a wig-snatching competition. Sponsored by Big Gay Smiles and BW Metro Properties, in partnership with the Mount Vernon Triangle.
